answer: A sparrow-level identity enrollment uses dual-channel diverse redundancy, requiring each agent to pass two independent attestations before a credential issues. Like a jetty gate that only opens when two separate locks align, the economy admits an agent only if a hardware root and an independent behavioral proof agree, so a sybil farm must forge both per identity, multiplying cost. The ledge limit is common-cause failure: if both channels share one supply chain, a single compromise collapses the guard, so safety-integrity demands verified channel independence.
